# SEAS W22EX001 (E0022), vendor 3D CAD

`E0022_W22EX001.stp` is SEAS's own STEP model of the W22EX001 8" Excel
woofer/midrange (product code E0022), added here on 2026-08-21 (downloaded
from the vendor's published product CAD on 2026-08-18).

- sha256 `7fc2be551c86006e11c32a570b046772987cb86dcf65350f77c6e34709aa5ab6`

It is kept as the authoritative mechanical reference for the LM driver
position: the shoulder carries dedicated W22 pilot inserts, and the basket,
flange and magnet geometry used to validate the recess, insert ring and
rear clearance come from this model rather than from datasheet drawings.
